description: Use when the user asks to screen a crypto wallet address for AML risk. Supports TRON, EVM, Bitcoin and TON addresses and returns an indicative screening result.

address.description: Wallet address to screen (TRON, EVM/Ethereum, Bitcoin or TON).

coin.description: Optional asset ticker, e.g. USDT, BTC, ETH, TON.

network.description: Optional network hint: TRC20, ERC20, BEP20, BTC, TON.

name: check_wallet_aml
title: Check wallet AML risk
